Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old MANUEL, beaming with pride. He is presented with a certificate and a trophy, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**MANUEL**
(overcome with emotion)
This Is The Most Incredible Honor I Could Ever Ask For!

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face as he holds up the trophy, a wide smile spreading across his weathered features.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel lies in bed, the trophy still clutched in his hand. He gazes up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes. Suddenly, his expression changes, and he begins to stare intensely at the ceiling.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I Remember Reading This Theory On The Internet When I Was Young... Quantum Immortality...

As he speaks, his voice becomes more agitated, his words tumbling out in a frantic rush.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
It Said That In A Multiverse, Every Time A Person Dies, Their Consciousness Creates A New Reality, And They Live On Forever. But What If I'm Not Just Any Person? What If I'm The Only One Who's Immortal?

Manuel's eyes widen, and his face contorts in a mixture of fear and excitement.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
What If I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived? What If I'm The Only One Who's Ever Died?

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face, his eyes bulging with madness.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER LIVED! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER DIED! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER...

Manuel's voice trails off, and he slumps forward, his head hitting the pillow with a thud. The camera lingers on his face, frozen in a mixture of terror and despair.

**FADE TO BLACK.**

**THE END.**
